findings.title: Breaking removal of findMany without updating callers
findings.body: The diff deletes InsightsBookingService.findMany (the Prisma BookingTimeStatusDenormalized findMany wrapper that merged auth/filter conditions) and replaces it with getBaseConditions returning Prisma.Sql. Only two files are changed in this PR, so any existing caller that imports InsightsBookingService and calls findMany will fail to compile at TypeScript time or throw TypeError: service.findMany is not a function at runtime. A service conversion must either keep findMany as a compatibility wrapper or migrate all call sites in the same PR.

findings.title: Org-scope test assumes deterministic DB ordering
findings.body: The org-scope authorization test asserts teamIds equal [org.id, team.id, team2.id, team3.id] and userIds equal [user.id, user2.id, user3.id] via toEqual on Prisma.sql. The service builds those arrays from TeamRepository.findAllByParentId and MembershipRepository.findAllByTeamIds with no orderBy, so Postgres return order is undefined. The test will be flaky and can fail even when authorization logic is correct, and it masks real ordering-independent correctness. Order results before comparing or compare as sets.
